meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 给 Claude 接入 Linear 频道:它会参与 Linear issue 的评论线程并自动回复,每条评论都触发它、不需要 @ 提及,每个 issue 的评论线程是独立会话。
howto.when: 当你在 Linear 里配置好的那个团队中,有人给 issue 留言时接管;无需 @ 提及,每条评论都会触发它。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 频道接进来,团队用 ENG
say.note: 按步骤复制适配器、注册并安装依赖

say.text: 我的 Linear 评论一直收不到,帮我排查 webhook
say.note: 检查 webhook URL、团队和签名密钥

say.text: 把 Linear 团队 NAN 接到我的 agent 上
say.note: 创建消息组并建立 wiring

howto.what_en: Adds a Linear channel so Claude takes part in Linear issue comment threads. Every comment on an issue triggers it — no @-mention needed — and each issue's comment thread is its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Kicks in when someone comments on an issue in the Linear team you wired up; no @-mention is needed. Each issue thread routes to one messaging group.

say_en.text: Add the Linear channel for my team ENG.
say_en.note: Copies, registers and installs the adapter.

say_en.text: Linear comments never reach the agent — check my webhook.
Wire Linear team NAN to my agent folder.
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring.
